Sam D: quick repro — edge sample resolves ESM but TS consumers lose types; require() and import shapes inconsistent. anyone seen this? :thinking_face:

Ben K: yep. usually `exports` present but no `types` mapping. paste your exports?

Sam D: snippet:
```json
"exports": {".": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.js","require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"},"./package.json": "./package.json"}
```
Top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" exists but editors can't find declarations when bundler-style resolution runs.

Chandra R: two fixes: add `types` inside `exports`, and publish a tiny CJS bridge that normalizes default (so `require()` and `import` see same shape). Example export block:
```json
"exports": {".": {"types": "./dist/index.d.ts","import": "./dist/esm/index.js","require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"}}
```
Also add a lightweight CI check: TS compile with `moduleResolution: bundler` + node require shape assertion.

Sam D: will add the `exports.types`, CJS wrapper in dist, and CI smoke tests; opening PR to samples/entrypoint-interop and will tag reviewers.
